title: B.Tech Information Technology | KSET KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSET Information Technology Krishna School of Emerging Technology & Applied Research prepares Information Technology students through emerging-tech exposure, practical laboratories, and application-led learning for the digital future. 0 Established 0 Student Intake 0 Core Competencies 0 Research Areas LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSET Ms. Apoorva Shah Head of Department, Information Technology hod.it.kset@kpgu.ac.in Department of Information Technology started its journey in 2021 with intake of 60 students, The objective of IT department is to impart knowledge in cutting-edge technologies in Information Technology. We take tremendous pride in our academic excellence; The Department has a dynamic, young and dedicated team, with specialization in a wide array of areas. Our faculty members blend advanced theories with practical Engineering applications, as we continue to meet our mission. In order to ensure quality education, we provide a continuous learning approach and research opportunities for students. As a department, we use project-based learning, case-based learning, expert talks and capstone projects to enhance the learning process. Accordingly, measures are taken to keep the students busy throughout the course. The periodically updated curriculum imparts technical knowledge, complemented by an application based environment in state of the art laboratories. The department collaborates with the industry through industrial visits and hands on practical sessions so that the students gain experience with the different technologies used in the industry. The department aims not only to make the students IT professionals, but also to groom them as responsible citizens of society, who will inspire future generations. It will be our responsibility to provide you with excellent education, we expect from you to work hard and go the extra mile to achieve your grand academic and personal goals. Please feel free to contact us on official email address provided on website. Thank you for visiting us ABOUT DEPARTMENT Digital Skills With Applied Learning 01 The Department of Information Technology was established in 2020 with the objective of imparting knowledge in cutting-edge technologies. 02 After creating successful computer professionals for the last 17 years at Babaria Institute of Technology we have now entered into education of Information Technology under our Global University. 03 The Department has a dynamic, young and dedicated team, with specialization in a wide array of areas. The Department has well- equipped laboratories with Computer Systems and facilities that are vital for training students in state-of-the-art software and hardware. The Department always strives to bring the latest technological advancements in this field to  young learners as well as aspirants by inviting corporate legends and experienced academicians to educate the IT community of our institution. The department supports students' self-learning capabilities through core strengths. CORE COMPETENCIES Specialized Capability Areas 01 Network Security 02 Big Data Analytics 03 Cloud Computing 04 Internet of Things 05 Artificial Intelligence 06 Machine learning 07 Data Science VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To become a great contributor towards Digital India by developing quality IT engineers, entrepreneurs, researchers who can compete globally. 01 To create worldwide competent students having ability to design, develop smart systems with intelligence. 02 To impart continuous learning, comprehensive research in emerging areas. 03 Exchanging expertise with research, industry and academic organizations. 04 To create an excellent environment for higher studies that leads to careers as smart IT Professionals in the extensively diversified domains of industry, government and academia.
